# Apple Notes

Apple Notes restyles Obsidian after Apple's Notes app, with warm off-white paper in light mode, a charcoal dark mode and the SF Pro font stack. Yellow carries the accents on links, folders and tags, checkboxes are round and gold, and highlights use a yellow highlighter. The layout uses a full-width editor, pill-shaped tags and rounded translucent modals.

![Apple Notes screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexxozo/apple-notes-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Apple Notes"
    author: "Alex Simion"

    github_url:     "https://github.com/alexxozo/apple-notes-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexxozo/apple-notes-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Bring Apple Notes styling to Obsidian with warm off-white paper in light mode and charcoal dark mode, SF Pro font stack, yellow accents for links/folders/tags, round gold checkboxes and yellow highlighter. Use a full-width editor, pill-shaped tags and rounded translucent modals for a native Notes feel."
}
```
